name: Mat3S16_MulQ12_Copy5
append:
[semantic-triple 2026-10-12] run01 closure; supervisor-verified CERTAIN local mechanics.
Reads signed WORD coefficients, performs x87 three-term row/column products, and stages three WORDs on each of three iterations with 6-byte row strides. There are no helper calls. Results are obtained from bits of floating stores, not an integer multiply/SHR or saturating conversion. Copies FIVE DWORDs (20 bytes) from its local staging area to argument 3 and leaves that destination pointer in full EAX. Only nine result WORDs (18 bytes) were generated; the final two copied stack bytes are not initialized as output coefficients by this routine. A destination of only 18 writable bytes is insufficient. Exact Q12/trigonometric/hardware equivalence and the meaning of those two stack bytes are not asserted.
